text:
paul-mktg: Quick find from the weekly KPI pass  Launch sprint posts surged — impressions and CTR are way up, but the 'net new MQLs' card is flat. Can analytics/ops eyeball attribution? :eyes:
ayana-analytics: seeing that. Registrations jump but MQLs not following. My hunch: recent param normalization plus our dashboard using a 7-day attribution window while benchmarks use 14.
jas-ops: we rolled a tiny inbound-mapper on 2026-04-11 that collapsed campaign variants into a canonical label. If dashboards filter on legacy names, rows may be excluded. I'll check routing logs.
omar-growth: also check partner widget traffic — it sometimes tags leads with partner_ref instead of utm_campaign which breaks the join.
ayana-analytics: quick debug SQL I'm running: ```sql
SELECT campaign_tag, count(*) as regs, sum(is_mql::int) as mqls
FROM analytics.joined_leads
WHERE cohort = 'launch_sprint_apr'
  AND event_date >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY regs DESC;
```
kpi-uploader: KPI deck uploaded: https://dash.redwood.ai/launch/sprint-apr (auto) :file_folder:  (shared: paul-mktg, ayana-analytics, jas-ops)
jas-ops: grep of router logs shows mapping at 2026-04-11T09:02Z: `map: campaign_alias=ls_apr_v2 -> campaign=launch_sprint` and a fallback that sets blank campaign -> 'unknown'. That fallback likely hides rows. Rolling a mapping shim and will backfill.
ayana-analytics: great — please backfill last 14 days. I'll compute a before/after delta and update the KPI slide with corrected MQLs and a small table showing 7d vs 14d attribution impact.
paul-mktg: For deck language keep it crisp: "Launch sprint driving strong attention; short-term MQL undercount due to tagging normalization and attribution window variance. Ops/Analytics reconciling; expect updated numbers after backfill"
omar-growth: recommend a tiny diagnostic micro-card on the KPI board: "campaign tag coverage" (percent leads with campaign) and "7d vs 14d MQL delta" so we can spot instrumentation shifts fast.
jas-ops: will add the monitor and alert if campaign coverage drops below 97% for major launches. Kicking backfill now, ETA ~2h.
ayana-analytics: will post the delta table when backfill completes and refresh the KPI deck. If numbers move up we'll keep the benchmark phrasing optimistic; if not, we'll run a message-quality check.
paul-mktg: thanks team. Can we reconvene Friday AM to finalize the headline? If backfill fixes it we mark as "instrumentation"; otherwise we escalate. :coffee:
